description: A sliding-window rate limiter: each client may make at most `limit` calls in any `window` seconds. `allow` records a permitted call and returns True, or returns False without recording anything; `remaining` and `retry_after` tell a client where it stands.

key.statement: allow refuses only when the count already exceeds the limit, so each client gets limit + 1 calls per window.
keywords: (should|must|needs to) be (>=|at least|greater than or equal)
